title: New eight-home development in Warboys approved despite resident objections
content: Find, save and share Public Notices that affect you in the area. Plans for a new eight-home development in Warboys have been approved despite objections from residents and the parish council. The proposal, from applicants Mr and Mrs Robinson, involves constructing eight detached homes on land between Heath Farm and Heath Pond, north of Heath Road in Warboys. The land is currently classed as agricultural. Plans include three three-bedroom and five four-bedroom homes, 16 parking spaces, landscaping and a footpath linking the site to the village. It was granted Permission in Principle in July 2025 for between four and nine homes, establishing that the site could be developed for housing. The plans include three-bedroom and four-bedroom homes, 16 parking spaces and landscaping (Image: Huntingdonshire Planning Portal) Despite the formal submission of these plans, the proposal has faced objections from Warboys Parish Council and residents.
